paper.title: Artificial intelligence-guided design of LNPs for in vivo targeted mRNA delivery via analysis of the spatial conformation of ionisable lipids
paper.main_article_pdf: NOT IN HAND. Only the 17 publisher ESM assets were downloaded (SI, peer-review file, Source Data). Main-text figure legends (Fig. 3, Fig. 4, Extended Data Fig. 2) are therefore unread; every assay annotation below is taken from a Supplementary legend or Supplementary Methods that covers the same Source Data, and each is cited.

library_size.established_how: Two independent enumerations of the same name list, read on 2026-11-10: (a) Supplementary Data 4 'Lipid_ML_ID_Correspondence_Table.xlsx' inside 41551_2026_1640_MOESM7_ESM.zip, rows 2-122 (ML ID -> lipid name); (b) Supplementary Fig. 1b (MOESM1 p.5, printed No./Lipid-name table, raster).
library_size.formulations_vs_structures: NOT the 'N lipids = N formulations' trap. Supplementary Table 3 (MOESM1 p.39) gives ONE in-vitro screening formulation for every lipid: ionisable lipid:DOPE:Chol:DMG-PEG2000 = 45:15:38.5:1.5. One row per lipid. A separate formulation sweep exists (Supplementary Fig. 26, lipid P1 only, 18 formulations of ONE lipid) and is excluded from the screen.

tiers.assay_evidence: Supplementary Fig. 10 legend, MOESM1 p.14: 'mRNA transfection efficiency in HEK293T cells. Luciferase expression following treatment of HEK293T cells with LNPs (1 ug mL-1 mFluc, 24 h). Data is presented as the mean +- s.d. (n = 3 ...)'

tiers.what: IN VIVO whole-animal luciferase total flux (n=3) for PBS, ALC-0315 and 12 library lipids (6, 11, 23, 29, 35, 42, 43, 49, 54, 55, 87, 107) -- Fig. 3i.
tiers.assay_in_vivo: mouse, luciferase total flux (p/s). Strain, route, dose and timepoint are NOT stated in the SI, the Methods or the peer-review file. Left blank -- DECISIONS.md D-3.
tiers.role: The LARGEST in-vivo source in the paper, and it was missed on the first pass over the workbooks because find_screens.py scores a sheet on distinct compound-like labels and Fig. 3's labels sit in column W of a 89-column sheet whose first panel is a per-lipid log10 table. ALC-0315's three values here are identical to Fig. 4c's in-vivo ALC-0315, so Fig. 3i and Fig. 4c in vivo are ONE experiment; ALC-0315 is emitted once.

tiers.role: The ONLY source of measured values for Lipid T1 and Lipid T2 (ML IDs 114, 115), which are not in the H-T library. T3-T12 duplicate V1 ids 107,108,109,110,1,25,33,40,53,87 exactly (verified, 30/30 cells).
tiers.caveat: ED Fig. 2d is a DIFFERENT assay (ALC-0315 = 37,328 vs 957,212 in 2c). Its legend is in the main article, which is not in hand, so 2d is NOT emitted. Open decision D-4. DECISIONS.md D-4.

tiers.what: label.txt - the ML regression target, one value per ML ID 1-121.

tiers.role: CROSS-CHECK ONLY. NOT emitted. tiers.what: STRUCTURES. Heads H1-H14, linkers (ester/amide), tails T1-T16, and the No. -> lipid-name table.
tiers.locus: Supplementary Fig. 1a (building blocks) and 1b (name table), p.5
tiers.why_tiers_1_to_4_failed: Checked, in order. (1) No publisher Source Data file contains a structure, SMILES or formula column - all 19 sheets of MOESM5 are 100x100 MD projection-density matrices and the other 8 workbooks are numeric panel data (enumerated in this file). (2) The SI has no structure table: Supplementary Tables 1-5 are corona proteins, corona proteins, formulations, vaccine-LNP characterisation and antibodies. (3) No author repository exists - find_repo.py over GitHub returned 0 candidate matches for the DOI, PMID, title and author; the only code released is MOESM6/7/8, which contain SISSO inputs and 100x100 density matrices keyed by ML ID, with no structure representation of any kind. (4) MOESM1 p.5 carries ONE embedded raster image (2484x3047 px) and ZERO vector drawing paths, confirmed with pymupdf get_drawings() == 0, so the PDF's own bond coordinates do not exist on that page and curation/lib/chains.vector_bonds necessarily returns [].
tiers.second_independent_method: HRMS. Supplementary Notes, MOESM1 pp.41-53, give 1H NMR and 'Mass calculated m/z ... found [M-H]- m/z ...' for a named subset of lipids. Exact mass pins the molecular formula and therefore every chain length in that lipid, independently of the raster trace. Mass is blind to connectivity (CLAUDE.md), so regiochemistry comes from the Michael-addition route in Supplementary Methods p.55, not from mass.

tiers.what: Synthesis route; head H11 and tail T14 drawn structures confirmed in words; general Michael addition.
tiers.role: Pins connectivity: 'All ionisable lipids were synthesized through the Michael addition reaction. Taking lipid P1 as an example, H4 (3 mmol) and T1 (7.5 mmol) ...' -> the (n) suffix is the number of tail arms.

decision: PROCEED. A per-lipid value source exists at tier 1 for 121 of 121 ML IDs (V1 covers 113 in vitro, V3 covers P1-P6, V4 covers Lipid T1-T2) and a tier-1 in-vivo source for 19 lipids (V7 + V3). Independent tier-1 cross-check (V2) and tier-3 cross-check (V5). Structures are tier-5 pixels with HRMS as the second method; that is the bottleneck, not the values.
